rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — no translation-content/operational-string catalog table in live schema
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL applied: although labeled '스키마 보강 필요', the 메모 explicitly states the confirmed contract is '사용자 선호 저장' (user-preference storage), and description.md (PRIMARY) only requires THIS screen to (a) select a learning locale and (b) show a fallback badge when a translation is missing — it never asks the screen to query/manage an operational translation catalog. UI strings are served by the build-time i18n catalog, not a runtime DB table. A translation-content management structure is a net-new OPERATIONAL/content capability (content-admin territory) outside this user screen's read/write surface → route to UNRESOLVED/escalate, do not apply. stableQueryNeed=false because no G-01 user-screen query needs it. (No DB write/seed.)

jsonMappingNote: No seed JSON exists for G-01 (folder contains description.md, functional-spec.md, screen-data-summary.md, wireframe.png; no sample JSON). JSON MAPPING RULE therefore not exercised; there is no source JSON file or item id to preserve as seed provenance. If a seed file is later added, map by document meaning first (ui locale -> profiles.ui_locale, learning locale/follow -> profiles.learning_locale [null=follow], the three option toggles -> profiles.content_prefs jsonb keys feedback_display/example_difficulty/explanation_length) and derive deterministic upsert ids from (source file + JSON item.id), never array index. Seeds would upsert on profiles.id (the user) — but profiles is a SHARED admin-first entity; do not seed beyond user-owned preference columns.
decisions: No additive migration proposed for G-01: every data requirement the user screen reads/writes (profiles.ui_locale, profiles.learning_locale, profiles.content_prefs, profiles.updated_at) already exists in the live schema. profiles columns learning_locale/content_prefs were added by migration 20260602120200 and are confirmed present in the live baseline.

content_prefs stays as jsonb (jsonb-covered, no promotion to columns): description.md treats the three options as whole-blob saved preferences with no per-key query/validation/render need; STABLE-QUERY rule says leave the blob. CHECK jsonb_typeof='object' already enforces the screen-data-summary '메모: JSON object 제약'.
learning_locale null = 'follow UI locale' is encoded by the nullable CHECK (IS NULL OR IN ('ko','en','vi')) — matches screen-data-summary 메모; no separate flag column needed.

번역 문구 catalog (스키마 보강 필요 label) -> UNRESOLVED via CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: confirmed contract is user-preference storage; runtime translation-content management is net-new operational/content-admin scope, escalated not applied. UI strings come from the build-time i18n catalog, not the DB.
Help copy, unsupported-language notice, sidebar/session behavior, and transient save state require no DB field; no invented columns (STABLE-QUERY rule).

profiles is a SHARED admin-first entity (app_role load-bearing for RLS): the screen reconciles TO it — own-row update of ui_locale/learning_locale/content_prefs only; protected columns app_role/plan_label/status untouched. No reshape, no admin/org schema added.
